blocks.text: Chapter ka yeh hissa jadeed zaraat mein chemistry ka kirdar dekhta hai. Yeh duniya ki barhti aabadi ke liye khurak ki farahmi barhane mein khaad (fertilisers), keera-maar adwiyat (pesticides) aur genetic engineering ki ahmiyat batata hai. Yeh fasalon aur mitti par tezabi barish ke kimiyai reactions aur mausami tabdeeli ke fasalon ki barhotri par asraat bhi batata hai.

blocks.prompt: Teen tareeqe batayein jin se chemistry khurak ki farahmi barhati hai.
blocks.explanation: Fertilisers, pesticides aur fasalon ki genetic engineering.

items: Zaraat: fertilisers, pesticides, genetic engineering, tezabi barish, mausami tabdeeli.
